title: Teams
intro: Organize the directory in teams: a team may belong to another one (a department, its teams, their squads). In a meeting, picking a team also picks its sub-teams.
namePlaceholder: Name of the team, e.g. Design
emptyHint: Create a first team, then put people in it from their card in the directory.
readOnly: Only the workspace's administrators change the teams.
deleteConfirm: Delete the team “{name}”? Its people stay in the directory without a team; its sub-teams move up one level.
noTeamHint: Their team is set from their card in the directory.
